name: hcapp_getDirectMessageRequests
description: Requests to message the caller that are still pending (E9.F1.S19): the other hasher's HC.HasherFriendMap row towards the caller exists with FriendSince NULL, Removed 0 and Ignore 0, the requester is not removed, and the caller has no live row back (none with Removed = 0) and has not blocked them (none with Ignore = 1). Shown at the top of the chat list with Accept / Decline. Read-only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 130, @param NULL); scoped to the token's user.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (a NULL is refused by ValidateAppAuth as 'Device not registered').

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone and the SP returns. No compact envelope.

rowsets.name: Requests
rowsets.description: On success: one row per pending request, newest first (ORDER BY HasherFriendMap.createdAt DESC). Empty when nothing is pending.

columns.name: FromPublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) of the requester; the app lowercases it on arrival.

columns.name: RequestedAt
columns.description: HasherFriendMap.createdAt of the requester's row — when they asked (column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_hasher_block.sql).

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error (CATCH, line 50).

codeSmells.detail: Line 39 returns FromPublicHasherId as UPPER(...). Ids are lowercase everywhere in the app; this relies on the adHoc reply door lowercasing it.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
